verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform with a CLI, SDK, and cloud service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Self-hosting gives infrastructure control, but that is an adjacent capability and not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
